paragraphs.en: The little prince greeted the merchant with a morning salutation.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子向商人致以清晨的问候。

paragraphs.en: "Good morning," replied the merchant. He sold pills designed to eliminate thirst, requiring only one pill per week.
paragraphs.zh: “早上好，”商贩应道。他售卖的是一种止渴药丸，只需每周服用一次即可。

paragraphs.en: "Why do you sell these?" inquired the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “你为什么卖这些？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "They save a lot of time," explained the merchant. "Experts have calculated that each week, you gain fifty-three minutes."
paragraphs.zh: “这样可以节省很多时间，”商人大声解释道，“专家们计算过，每周你能多出53分钟。”

paragraphs.en: "What can I do with those extra minutes?"
paragraphs.zh: “多出来的这几分钟我能用来做什么？”

paragraphs.en: "If you wish, you could walk towards a spring of fresh water," mused the little prince to himself.
paragraphs.zh: “如果你愿意，可以走向一口清泉。”小王子自言自语道。
